preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 20,000.
The number of vertices n in each test case must be between 2 and 200,000.
The number of edges m in each test case must be between 1 and the minimum of 200,000 and n(n-1)/2.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= n and 1 <= y_i <= n for x_i, y_i in edges)
preconditions.description: All vertices x_i and y_i in the edges must be within the range of 1 to n.
The total number of vertices and edges across all test cases must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be 'NO' if it's impossible to direct edges, or 'YES' followed by m lines of directed edges.

postconditions.expression: all(edge in directed_edges for edge in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: All directed edges in the output must be valid and correspond to the input edges.

postconditions.expression: not any(cycle in directed_edges for cycle in cycles)
postconditions.description: The resulting directed graph must not contain any directed cycles.
